name: @leaflow/sdk
description: TypeScript SDK for the Leaflow platform APIs

scripts.build: pnpm generate && node scripts/fix-generated-imports.mjs && node scripts/build-index.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm generate && node scripts/fix-generated-imports.mjs && node scripts/build-index.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
